title: Greenroom pixi.toml (ROS)
description: Pixi manifest schema extended with the [tool.ros] table consumed by the vinca pixi shim. Pixi only honors third-party metadata under [tool.*], so the ROS-specific fields live there. Use as the schema for any pixi.toml that backs a ROS conda package. See SCHEMA_NOTES.md for the rationale.

RosMetadata.title: ROS-specific metadata
RosMetadata.description: Vinca-shim-specific package metadata. Drives the generated package.xml when this pixi.toml is consumed as a ROS package manifest.

build_type.title: ament build type
build_type.description: Maps to <export><build_type/></export> in the generated package.xml. Required.

is_message_package.title: Message/srv/action package
is_message_package.description: If true, the shim emits <buildtool_depend>rosidl_default_generators</buildtool_depend> and <member_of_group>rosidl_interface_packages</member_of_group> so rosidl generators discover this package and produce bindings.

test_dependencies.title: Test dependencies
test_dependencies.description: Additional deps used during tests. Same shape as [package.run-dependencies] — keys are conda names, values are version specs (`*`, `==X`, `>=X,<Y`, etc.).
